Who went vp and ſayd to him ſitting in the top ot the haire, and di- mount: Man of God the king hathcommanded that thou come downe.tinct habite, 1o. And Elias anſwering, ſayd to the captaine of fiftie men: If I bea from ordinary man of God, (b) let fyre come downe from heauen, and. deuour thee, men. and thy fittie. Fyre therfore came downe from heauen, and deuoured iuſtice Elias him and the fiftie men that were with him. Andhe ſent againe vnto procured tre- him an othet captaine of fittie inen, and his fiftie with him. Who ſpake from heauen to him: Mauof God, thus ſaith the King: Make haſt, come downe. Elias anſwering ſaid : It I be a man of God, let fyre come downe trom heauen, and deuour thee, and thy fittie. Fyre thertore came downe from es and their men, as he heauen, & deuoured him, & his fiftie. Agayne he ſent a third captaine procured fre ot fiftie men and the fiftie that were with him. Who when he was to burne the come, bowed his knees toward Elias, and prayed him and ſayd: Manof God deſpiſe not my life aud the liues of thy ſeruants that are with me. Behold fyre eame downe from heauen, and hath deuoured the two then ſlew the firſt captaynes of fiftie men, and the fifties, that were with them: but.2 now I beſeech thee that thou haue mercie on my lite. Aud an Angel of out Lord ſpake to Elias, ſaying: Goe downe with him, teare not. He therfore aroſe, and went downe with him to the king, aud ſpake to him: Thus ſaith our Lord: Becauſe thou haſt ſent meſſengers to conſult Beelzebub the God of Accaron, as though there were not a God in Iſ- tael, ot whom thou mighteſt aske the word, therfore froin the bed which thou art aſcended vpon, thou ſhalt not deſcend, but dying thou ſhalt die. He died therfore according to the word ot our Lord which Eias ſpake, andloram his brother reigned for him, in the ſecond yeare of Ioram the ſonne ot Ioſaphat the kingot Iuda: for he had no ſoune. But the reſt of the words of Ochorias, which he wrought are not theſe written in the Booke of the words of the daies of the kings of Iſtaelꝰ de mirabil. S. Seript.
